title: Skip Your Turn
description: You are safe! Skip this turn.

title: Extra Points
description: Instantly gain 50 extra points.

title: Spin Again
description: You get a free extra spin.

title: Choose Another Player
description: Pick someone else to take your punishment or task.

title: Steal Points
description: Steal 20 points from the player in first place.

title: Double Points
description: Points for your next action are doubled.

title: Immunity
description: You cannot receive a punishment for the next 2 rounds.

title: Reverse
description: Change the turn order direction.

title: Give a Dare
description: You get to invent a dare for any player.

title: Veto Power
description: You can cancel one rule or punishment later in the game.

title: Free Pass
description: Keep this card to skip any future turn.

title: Point Shower
description: Everyone gets 10 points, but you get 30.

title: Make a Rule
description: Create a rule everyone must follow. You are exempt.

title: Truth Immunity
description: You never have to answer a truth question for the rest of the game.

title: Dare Immunity
description: You never have to do a physical dare for the rest of the game.

title: The Decider
description: You settle all disputes for the rest of the game.

title: DJ Privilege
description: You have absolute control over the music playlist.

title: VIP Seating
description: You can demand anyone's seat and they must move.

title: Snack King
description: Someone must bring you a snack of your choice.

title: Skip the Loser
description: The person in last place loses their next turn.

title: Protect a Friend
description: Give immunity to another player for one round.

title: Point Swap
description: Swap your score with the person to your left.

title: Multiplier
description: All points earned this round are tripled.

title: Free Drink
description: Someone must fetch you a beverage.

title: Silent Treatment Immunity
description: You can talk even if a rule says otherwise.

title: Task Master
description: Assign any mini-game to two players of your choice.

title: The Royal Treatment
description: Everyone must refer to you as 'Your Majesty' for 3 rounds.

title: Instant Win
description: Instantly win this specific mini-game or round.

title: Shield
description: Block the next negative effect aimed at you.

title: Bankrupt
description: Reduce the first place player's score by half.
